step.cmd: Determine the type of undeliverable mail that was returned:

ul.li: If the undeliverable mail is a D-91-00-00 warning letter that includes an unclassified violation (in FTS, on the Violation History [ML02] screen, 1 - Violation - warning letter issued is displayed in the Warning Letter field), go to step 2.
If the undeliverable mail is a notice of decision that set up an OP or a penalty, go to step 5.
If the undeliverable mail is a D-91-00-00 letter that does not include an unclassified violation (in FTS, on the Violation History [ML02] screen, the Warning Letter field is blank), go to step 5.
If the undeliverable mail is a notice of decision unrelated to a Notice of Debt, go to step 6.
If the undeliverable mail is any other ACS letter, go to step 6.
If the undeliverable mail is a benefit statement with an access code, go to step 8.
If the undeliverable mail is none of the above, go to step 7.

step.cmd: Determine if there is an OP related to the D-91-00-00 warning letter that includes an unclassified violation:
In FTS, from the Violation (ML01) screen, add a new notification week and rescind the one that was initially entered as follows:

ul.li:
To add the new notification week:
Action: Select Add .
Notification week: Select the current w/c.
BPC: Select the same BPC as initially selected.
Imposed by: Select 1 - Officer .
Warning Letter: Select 1 - Violation - warning letter issued .
Actual OP: Enter the potential OP as initially entered, if necessary.
Potential OP: Enter the potential OP as initially entered, if necessary.
Select Update .

To rescind the original notification week:
Select the original violation.
Action: Select Rescind.
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send a new D-91-00-00 decision letter with the same information as the original decision. Go to step 10.
Determine if the Notice of Debt that is related to the undeliverable notice of decision was returned as undeliverable:

ul.li: If the Notice of Debt was not returned as undeliverable, go to step 6.
If the Notice of Debt was returned as undeliverable, go to step 10.

step.cmd: From the appropriate electronic system (i.e. ACS, FTS, Imaging) print a copy of the undeliverable mail.
Address an envelope with the client’s new address, enclose the undeliverable mail and send it to the client. Go to step 10.
In FTS, determine if the access code has been reissued:
In FTS, reissue the access code .
In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li:
Details: Type one of the following options:
“[Type of undeliverable mail] originally sent [date] received as undeliverable on [date] — resent to the client’s new address.”
“Notice of decision not resent to the client’s new address as the Notice of Debt was also undeliverable.”
“Access code reissued.”

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the AI WI.
